notes.title: God's Trigger is LIVE! Your fight for laptops starts NOW!!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32942895/b9eda72636290be7c21d60f25e33f4c7e199a357.jpg

NO TIME TO WASTE - SLAY AND WIN!
Show us how it’s done – be quick, kill with style and get your chance TO WIN Alienware gaming laptop!
How to play?
Just as there are TWO heroes in God's Trigger, there are TWO ways to win one of THREE shiny Alienware gaming laptops:

FOR SOLO PLAYERS
1. Finish the 3rd level in 1st chapter with best time
2. Upload the video of your playthrough to YouTube with #GodsTrigger and "God's Trigger" in the title 
3. Paste your link in the comment section on facebook post
4. Be the best and win!

FOR CO-OP TEAMS
1. Finish the 3rd level in 4th chapter together with best time
2. Upload the video of your playthrough to YouTube with #GodsTrigger and "God's Trigger" in the title
3. Paste your link in the comment section on facebook post
4. Be the best and win!

What you need to remember?
In case of tied entries, we will choose the most stylish and cool playthrough. You can use any and all of the abilities and builds in the game, so it pays to be creative and deadly. Multiple entries in different categories are permitted, but you may win only once;)

Prizes:
1st place in Solo - Alienware 17'' R5
1st place in Duo - 2x Alienware 15'' R4
